name: serverUrl
label: Server URL
help: The base address of the Automate server, without `/cwa/api/v1` or `/automate`.

pattern.message: Enter the server's base https address, e.g. https://yourcompany.hostedrmm.com

name: username
label: Username
help: Use an Automate integrator user, which can sign in to the API without two-factor authentication.

name: clientId
label: Client ID
help: Required by Automate 2020 Patch 11 and later. Get one from the [ConnectWise Developer Network](https://developer.connectwise.com/ClientID).
